entries.en: to obey with reverence; to comply reverently
entries.notes: H 第二字『俊/逡』不定，但 L、M、H 首字（遵/chún）及词义互证为『遵从』。

entries.zh: 遵命；服从（神父、长上的）命令
entries.en: to obey (the Fathers'); to comply with an order
entries.notes: L 缩写 P.p. 推为『Padres』（神父），义据 H『遵命』。

entries.zh: 孝心；孝顺（父母、尊长）之心
entries.en: filial devotion; dutifulness toward parents and superiors
entries.notes: L 缩写 P.p.（Padres）与 H『孝心』之间以『孝顺长上』相衔接。

entries.en: filial obedience; dutiful submission to parents and elders
entries.notes: 同前条，L 之 P.p. 属缩写展开，H『孝順』与 M hàu sūn 密合。

entries.zh: 夫唱妇随；妻子顺从丈夫
entries.en: a wife obeys her husband; the husband leads, the wife follows
entries.notes: L 缩写 mug.=mujer（妻子）；M 第三音节作 hū，与『夫』同形，疑原稿如此。

entries.zh: 同等服从（两方）；持平对待
entries.en: to obey both alike; to treat or rule even-handedly
entries.notes: L 截断作 amd-，H『平治』与『同样服从』语义衔接不明，难以定夺。

entries.en: fitting, proper; it is meet or obligatory
entries.notes: L『g. conuiem.』为缩写兼截断，义由 H『合當』与 M hāy tāng 定；R 栏五音节与 H 不合。

entries.en: ought; to owe or be liable for (an obligation, a debt)
entries.notes: H 仅一字『該』而 M 作 cāy hō 两音节，疑与原稿串行或衍音。

entries.en: to bear (a duty); it is incumbent upon one
to bear or undertake (a charge); to hold responsibility
entries.notes: H 有 [疑:任/心]，然 M xīm 与 L『obligacion』皆指向『任』。

entries.en: as it ought to be; naturally (kai-jiân)
entries.notes: H 栏仅存『然』，M 作 cāy xiēn（該然），R 栏 damaetta… 不可读，栏位互错。

entries.en: ought to; should
entries.notes: R 栏作 ēng tūng（應當），与 M 之 ēng cāy 同义异文。

entries.zh: 本分；分内之责，（每年）常例义务
entries.en: one's bounden duty; annual dues or obligation

entries.zh: 省人事：明晓人事、懂事；（每年）省察人事
entries.en: to be sensible of human affairs; to examine one's conduct
entries.notes: H 有 [疑:省/生]，且『省人事』与 L『每年义务』语义不合，无法定夺。

entries.en: to take charge of affairs; to undertake duties
to discharge one's duty; to do one's utmost in office
ought; as is fitting (word order 然該 for 該然)
entries.notes: H、M 皆作『然該』（jiên-kai），词序与习见『該然』相反，义当相同。

entries.en: ought to; it is proper
fitting, proper; to behove
it is only fitting; ought indeed

entries.zh: 缚定：订定、拘束（约定义务），绑牢不移
entries.en: bound fast; firmly settled or contracted (a binding obligation)
entries.notes: R 栏作 pag hang，与 M 之 pag tia 微异，疑为异文或误录。

entries.zh: 感动；以恩义打动人、使人感恩承义
entries.en: to move or touch (someone); to put under obligation by kindness
entries.notes: M 多一音节 moūn 无对应汉字；义与次条『obligar con buenas obras』相承。

entries.en: 〔原件残缺，释义存疑〕
entries.notes: H、M、R 三栏俱空，仅存西语词头，无从释义。
